DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その楽器をお使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to use that instrument?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい電子鍵盤を持ってきました。管理棟の外に差込口が見えたので、使えるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電子鍵盤のため見える差込口の使用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a small electronic keyboard. I saw an outlet outside the management building, and I would like to ask whether I can use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can use the visible outlet for an electronic keyboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見える差込口を、利用者が自由に使えるわけではありません。まだ接続していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: An outlet being visible does not mean visitors may use it freely. You have not connected it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。コードを出す前に確認します。許可がないなら、勝手につなぎません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接続を伝え無許可接続をしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I will check before taking out the cable. Without permission, I will not plug it in on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not connected it and will not do so without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 演奏の利用条件についても、管理担当へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also need to check the conditions for playing instruments with the management staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 音が小さいから申込みはいらないと思っていました。今日は音を出さず、鍵盤の位置を覚える練習だけでも相談が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無音の鍵位置練習でも条件確認が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought no application was needed because the sound is quiet. Even if I only practice remembering key positions without making sound today, do I need to ask about it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether even silent practice of key positions requires checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 楽器の使い方と場所の希望を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the staff how you intend to use the instrument and where.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 机を借りる前提ではありません。自分のひざに載せる案ですが、それで利用できると決めずに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 机借用でなく膝上案だが許可未定と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am not assuming I can borrow a table. My idea is to put it on my lap, but I will ask without assuming that makes it permitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear in Japanese that you propose using your lap rather than borrowing a table, and permission is not yet established.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ確認する間は、楽器をかばんへ戻していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Could you put the instrument back in your bag while we check with the staff?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻しました。延長コードも広げていません。使える条件が分からなければ、今日は練習せず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 楽器とコード収納後に条件不明なら持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put it back. I have not laid out an extension cord either. If the conditions for using it are unclear, I will take it home without practicing today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the instrument and cord are packed and you will take them home if the conditions are unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、管理担当へ確認します。お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check with the management staff. Please wait. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前でお困りのようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem to be having trouble in front of the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同行している父が切符を探しています。後ろに人が並んだので、急がせてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父を切符探しで急がせたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father, who is with me, is looking for his ticket. People lined up behind us, so I ended up rushing him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you rushed your father while he was looking for his ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いったん横で、落ち着いて探していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you step aside for a moment and look calmly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の背中を押して進ませるのはやめます。私も一緒に横へ移ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 背中を押すのをやめ一緒に改札横へ移ると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will stop pushing my father's back to make him move forward. May I step aside with him too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop pushing his back and ask to move to the side of the gates together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。列が動く所から離れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Please move away from where the line is moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父が自分で探すと言っています。私がかばんを取り上げず、必要なら手伝うと声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の自己決定を尊重し必要時だけ援助すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father says he wants to look himself. I will not take his bag from him, but will tell him I can help if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will respect your father's own choice and help only when needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切符のことで案内が必要でしたら、私にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need help with the ticket, please let me know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見つかりました。ただ、父が行き先を心配しているので、本人へ説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符発見後に父本人への行先説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We found it. But my father is worried about the destination. Could you explain it directly to him?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the ticket has been found and ask for the destination to be explained to your father himself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらの駅まで行かれるのか、ご本人に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask him which station he is traveling to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私は隣で待ちます。分かったつもりで代わりに答えず、父が確認してから通ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の確認を待ち代答せず改札を通る方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait beside him. I will not assume I understand and answer for him; we will go through after my father has checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for your father's own confirmation and go through the gates without answering for him.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お父様へ伺います。お二人ともお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will speak to your father. Have a safe journey, both of you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申込書の内容についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the contents of the application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人に参考用の記入例を借りました。でも、その人の事情まで自分の欄へ写してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の記入例の事情まで転記したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I borrowed a completed example from an acquaintance for reference. But I also copied that person's circumstances into my own sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you copied your acquaintance's circumstances from their sample form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま提出せず、ご本人の事情として書いた箇所を見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than submitting it as it is, let us review the parts written as your own circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この「一人暮らし」は私には当てはまりません。私は姉と住んでいるので、例文と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人暮らしの例と姉との同居という事実の差を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This “living alone” does not apply to me. I live with my older sister, so my situation differs from the example.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the difference between the sample's living-alone statement and the fact that you live with your older sister.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支援の対象かどうかは、担当が条件と実際の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the conditions and your actual situation to determine whether you qualify for support.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人暮らしに直せば対象になると考えず、今の暮らしを正しく説明します。新しい紙に書き直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象になるため虚偽にせず新用紙を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will explain my actual living situation correctly, rather than think changing it to “living alone” would make me eligible. Could I rewrite it on a new form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a new form rather than making a false statement to qualify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用紙をお渡しします。不明な欄は、担当へ確認する印を付けても結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will give you a form. You may mark any unclear sections to check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 収入の欄は計算方法が分かりません。知人の数字を使わず、質問する箇所として印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 収入計算不明欄へ質問印を付け借用数字を使わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know how to calculate the income section. I will mark it as something to ask about, rather than use my acquaintance's figures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will mark the unclear income calculation for a question and will not use borrowed figures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認に必要な資料も担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will also explain which documents are needed for confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は書き終えたことにせず、自分の事情と未確認の欄を分けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完成扱いせず本人事情と未確認欄を分け相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will not treat the form as finished. I will distinguish my own circumstances from the sections still needing confirmation when asking for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not treat it as complete and will distinguish your actual circumstances from unconfirmed fields when consulting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの担当窓口へご案内します。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the appropriate counter. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これからの採血について、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check about your upcoming blood draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 針よりも、血の入った容器を見るのが苦手です。目に入らないようにすることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 血の容器を見るのが苦手と採血前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: More than the needle, I have trouble seeing the containers holding blood. Could you keep them out of my view?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese before the blood draw about your difficulty seeing containers of blood.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 準備の位置を確認します。今、気分が悪いわけではないですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check where the equipment is set up. You are not feeling unwell right now, are you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は大丈夫です。でも容器が見えると怖くなるので、顔をどちらへ向ければよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現状は平気だが視線の向きの案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am fine now. But seeing the containers frightens me, so please tell me which way I should turn my face.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you feel fine now but ask which way to look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちら側を向いていただけます。腕は急に動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can face this way. Please do not move your arm suddenly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 顔だけ向けて、腕は動かさないようにします。目を閉じる前に、始める時に声を掛けてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 腕を動かさず開始前の声掛けを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will turn only my face and keep my arm still. Before I close my eyes, I would like you to tell me when you are about to start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a warning before starting, and say you will keep your arm still.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 始める前にお知らせします。気分の変化はすぐに教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell you before starting. Please tell me immediately if you feel any change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終わるまで我慢して黙っているのではなく、気分が悪くなったらその時点で言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 気分変化時は黙って我慢せず申告すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I start feeling unwell, I will say so at that point rather than endure it silently until the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report any change in how you feel instead of silently putting up with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わった後も、ご様子を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how you are feeling afterward too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終わってから容器を見せてもらう必要はありません。終わったという声の案内だけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了後も容器提示ではなく声の終了案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is no need to show me the containers afterward either. Please just tell me aloud that it is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a spoken notice that it is finished rather than being shown the containers afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認しました。では、準備を進めます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have noted your wishes. We will proceed with preparations. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の自転車を自分の物だと思って家へ持ち帰ってしまいました。さっき友人から連絡があり、間違いに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の自転車を誤って持帰ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took my friend's bicycle home thinking it was mine. My friend contacted me a little while ago, and I realized the mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice in Japanese after mistakenly taking your friend's bicycle home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の自転車だと思った理由を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me why you thought it was your own bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ色の物を一緒に置いていました。自分の鍵が見つからず、友人が以前貸してくれた鍵を使ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同色と以前借りた鍵の使用を具体的に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: We had parked bicycles of the same color together. I could not find my own key, so I used a key my friend had lent me previously.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese specifically that the bicycles were the same color and you used a key borrowed previously.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつ、どこから持ち帰ったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When and where did you take it from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の昼、友人の家の前からです。友人には今、私の家にあると伝えましたが、返し方をまだ相談していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻場所と本人へ所在連絡済みで返し方未相談と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At noon today, from in front of my friend's house. I told my friend it is now at my house, but we have not yet discussed how to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State in Japanese the time and place, that you already told your friend its location, and that you have not discussed returning it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人との連絡は取れるのですね。今後の対応を確認するため、経緯を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you can contact your friend. Let us organize the sequence of events to check what should happen next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡は取れます。知らない誰かが盗んだという話を広めないよう、私が持ち帰ったことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他者盗難のうわさを広めず自分の行動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I can. I will explain that I took it home, so no rumor spreads that an unknown person stole it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain your own actions rather than spread a rumor that someone else stole it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人からすでに相談があったかなども、確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also need to check whether your friend has already reported the matter, among other things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にその点を尋ねます。自分の物に似ているからと黙って返すのではなく、取り違えの説明をしてから返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の相談済み状況を確認し説明して返す意向を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my friend about that. Rather than quietly return it because it looks like mine, I want to explain the mix-up before returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check whether your friend has already sought help and explain the mix-up before returning the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 伺った内容を確認し、対応をご案内します。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will confirm what you have told me and explain how to proceed. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。箱には電気ポットの絵がありますが、中身は手編みのマフラーです。元の箱を再利用しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポット印刷の再利用箱にマフラーを入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The box has a picture of an electric hot-water pot, but inside is a hand-knitted scarf. I reused the original box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the reused box printed with a hot-water pot contains a scarf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容品については、実際に入っている物を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let us confirm what is actually inside as the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ポットや電池は入っていません。マフラー一枚だけで、絵を見て説明してしまわないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電気製品や電池でなくマフラー一枚と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no hot-water pot or battery inside. It contains only one scarf, and I want to avoid describing it based on the picture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear in Japanese that it contains one scarf rather than an electrical appliance or batteries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容品の欄にも、実際の品物をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also enter the actual item in the contents field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「マフラー」と書きます。箱の印刷を全部消すために、箱を切り取る必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容品記入と箱切取りの要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write “scarf.” Do I need to cut parts off the box to remove all the printed pictures?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the contents entry in Japanese and ask whether cutting the box is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱を傷めず使えるか、外装の状態を確認します。古い宛名があれば外してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the packaging to see whether it can be used without damaging the box. Please remove any old address label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前の宛名ラベルが裏にありました。これを外してから、新しい宛名を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏の古い宛名ラベルを見つけ除去すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was an old address label on the back. I will remove it before attaching the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you found an old address label on the back and will remove it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 外装を整えたら、改めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check it again once the packaging is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い宛名を外しました。中身の説明はマフラー一枚でお願いします。ポットの箱だったこととは区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古いラベル除去後に実物と印刷を区別して受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I removed the old address. Please record the contents as one scarf. I will distinguish that from the fact that it used to be a hot-water-pot box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the old label is removed and ask for acceptance based on the actual contents, distinguishing them from the printing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容品と外装を確認いたします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the contents and packaging. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 銀行の説明で確認したいことがございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you would like to clarify in the bank's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 後で忘れそうなので、説明を録音しようとスマートフォンを出しました。先に録音してよいか聞くべきでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 事前確認せず録音準備したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took out my smartphone to record the explanation because I might forget later. I should have asked permission to record first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you prepared to record without checking beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ録音は始めていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not started recording yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 始めていません。隣のお客様の声も入るかもしれないので、ここでは録音をやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 録音未開始を伝え周囲の声を理由に取りやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. Other customers' voices might also be captured, so I will not record here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that recording has not started and you will cancel it because nearby voices might be captured.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な点は、メモを取りながらご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can take notes while checking the points you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メモに口座番号を全部書くのは避けたいです。今日質問したい手続きの名前だけ、書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 口座番号を残さず手続き名のメモを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to avoid writing my entire account number in the notes. Could you write down only the name of the procedure I want to ask about today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a note of the procedure name without leaving a record of the account number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手続きの名称をお伝えします。内容が分からない時は、その場でお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell you the name of the procedure. If anything is unclear, please ask at the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手続きの名前を書けました。説明を聞きながら全部書くと追いつかないので、区切りごとに待っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記入速度が追いつかず説明を区切って待つよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written the name down. I cannot keep up if I write everything while listening, so could you pause for me after each part?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the explanation to be divided into parts with pauses because you cannot write quickly enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 短く区切ってご説明します。書き終わりましたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain in short parts. Please tell me when you have finished writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 区切りごとに書けたか伝えます。最後に自分のメモを読み上げ、聞き違いがないか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区切りごとの記入完了を伝え最後にメモを読み上げて確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell you after each part whether I have written it down. Finally, I would like to read my notes aloud to check I have not misheard anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report when each part is written and read your notes aloud at the end to check them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。メモをお持ちください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the person in charge. Please bring your notes. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの箱へ、何を入れようとなさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What were you about to put in that box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お店への意見を書いた紙です。入口にあったので、アンケートの回収箱だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食品寄付箱を意見回収箱と間違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A piece of paper with comments about the shop. It was at the entrance, so I thought it was a survey collection box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook the food donation box for a comments collection box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは食品を集めるための箱です。紙はまだ入れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This box is for collecting food. You have not put the paper inside yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ手に持っています。箱の上の説明を読まず、形だけで判断していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙は未投入で形だけの判断だったと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am still holding it. I judged by its shape without reading the explanation above the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that you have not put the paper in and judged only by the shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お客様のご意見は、こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can take your comments here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この紙には名前を書いていません。商品の置き場所についての意見でも、渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 匿名の商品の置き場所意見を提出できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not write my name on this paper. May I give it to you even though it is a comment about where products are placed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can submit anonymous feedback about product placement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、どの売場についてか分かるようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please make clear which section you mean.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 野菜の売場です。小さい袋が高い棚にあって、手が届きにくかったと書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 野菜売場の小袋が高く届きにくいと具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The vegetable section. I wrote that small bags were on a high shelf and difficult to reach.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese that the small bags in the vegetable section were high up and hard to reach.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 売場へ伝えます。ご自身が見た棚についてのご意見ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the section staff. Your feedback concerns a shelf you saw yourself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は一つの棚だけを見ました。店の全部が届きにくいという書き方にはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一棚だけの観察で全店舗へ一般化していないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I only looked at one shelf. I did not write that everything in the shop was hard to reach.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you observed just one shelf and did not generalize it to the whole shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙をお預かりします。お知らせいただきありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take your paper. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチのことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a problem with the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 靴ひもを結ぶ時に足を座面へ載せて、泥を付けてしまいました。誰かが座る前にお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 靴ひも結びで座面へ泥を付けたと職員へ申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my foot on the seat to tie my shoelace and got mud on it. I wanted to tell you before someone sits there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese to a staff member that you got mud on the seat while tying your shoelace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分に泥が付きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part has mud on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端のこの部分です。靴底の泥で、ベンチ全体が汚れたというわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端の一部に靴底の泥が付き全体ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This part at the end. It is mud from my shoe sole; the whole bench is not dirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out in Japanese that mud from your shoe sole is on part of the end rather than the whole bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員が状態を確認します。もう靴は下ろしてありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check it. You have already taken your foot down, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。もう一方の足も載せるつもりでしたが、やめました。ひもは地面に足を置いて結び直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 足を下ろし別足を載せず地面でひもを結んだと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I was going to put my other foot up too, but stopped. I retied the lace with my foot on the ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you lowered your foot, did not put the other one up, and tied your laces on the ground.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で薬品などを使って拭かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not wipe it yourself using chemicals or similar products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かばんに消毒用の液がありますが、素材に合うか分からないので使いません。職員の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 素材との適合不明で持参消毒液を使わず確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have disinfectant liquid in my bag, but I will not use it because I do not know whether it suits the material. I will wait for staff to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not use your disinfectant because its suitability for the material is unknown, and will wait for a check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに同じような汚れを付けた所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you made any similar marks elsewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一か所だけです。汚れた所へ荷物を置いて隠さず、こちらで場所をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 汚れは一か所で荷物で隠さず場所を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just this one spot. I will not hide it by putting belongings over the dirty area; I will tell you where it is here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there is only one dirty spot, and you will indicate it without hiding it under your belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせいただきありがとうございます。状態を確認しますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us. I will check its condition now. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時刻をお確かめですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅の時計が九時を指していて、会議に遅れたと思いました。でも予定表の表示が違うので、自分の設定が心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅時計と会議予定表の時刻差で設定を心配すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The station clock says nine, and I thought I was late for a meeting. But my calendar shows something different, so I am worried about my settings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your concern about settings because the station clock and your meeting calendar show different times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車のご案内は駅の表示で確認できます。会議の予定は主催者へお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check train information on the station displays. Please confirm the meeting schedule with the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: オンラインの会議なので、予定表が外国の時刻になっていたかもしれません。駅の時計を直してほしいという話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 海外時刻の可能性を説明し駅時計修正要請でないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is an online meeting, so my calendar might have been showing a foreign time zone. I am not asking you to correct the station clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a foreign time zone may be involved, and make clear you are not asking for the station clock to be corrected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: スマートフォンの設定については、こちらでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine your smartphone's settings here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。会議の主催者に、日本時間では何時か聞きます。確認しながら通路に立っていたので、横へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 主催者へ日本時刻を照会し通路から移ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will ask the meeting organizer what time it is in Japan. I was standing in the passage while checking, so I will move aside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask the organizer for the Japan time and move out of the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動中は画面ばかり見ず、周囲にも気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When moving, please pay attention to your surroundings as well as the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先ほど駅の時計が間違っていると言ってしまったので、訂正します。まだ自分の予定の時刻を確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅時計誤りという先ほどの発言を未確認として訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I said earlier that the station clock was wrong, so I would like to correct that. I have not yet confirmed the time of my own appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct in Japanese your earlier claim that the station clock was wrong because your own schedule remains unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。乗車のご相談はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Do you need any help with your train journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会議時刻が確認できてから列車を選びます。遅刻だと決めて走らず、まず相手から返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会議時刻確認後に列車を選び走らず返答を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose a train after confirming the meeting time. Rather than assume I am late and run, I will wait for their reply first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose a train after checking the meeting time and wait for a reply rather than run.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、通路を空けてお待ちください。お気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait with the passage clear. Take care. Goodbye.
